verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM's pricing page documents a first-party spreadsheet import capability, so the core import exists. Nothing in the pack describes how import maps columns to fields, validates rows, or reports rejected rows. The Bulk Write API and its job-status callback are developer building blocks, not the founder-facing import flow, so they are not credited. missing for 10: documented column-to-field mapping, row validation rules, per-row error or rejection reports guaranteeing no silent data loss, deal/contact association during import, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can import my spreadsheet of contacts and deals with field mapping and validation, without losing rows silently

citations.quote: Import data from spreadsheets for free.
